start.description:
Start datetime of the time range. The start date is inclusive of the date mentioned.
E.g. '2010-01-01T00:00:00' (everything starting from '2011-01-01T00:00:00' will be included)

end.description:
End datetime of the time range. The end date is exclusive of the date mentioned.
E.g. '2011-01-01T00:00:00' (everything before '2011-01-01T00:00:00' will be included)

_size.description: length of this time-info in intervals. I.e. size of the timeseries this info represents.

_isAligned.description: true if time range is aligned with interval.

parent.description: parent Id for the timeseries. This will be used to look up the parent

projection.description:
to specify the ts field for which data is desired
e.g. sum(tsField), missing(tsField), count(tsField), avg(tsField), earliest(tsField), latest(tsField)

filter.description: Filter to be applied on the timeseries data points while normalizing

vars.description: Bind variables for a filter to be applied on the timeseries data points while normalizing

group.description: Group by field name on the data point type. You can specify comma separated field names to group by multiple fields

include.description: Fields to be included in the result
